# discord_local_image (Data Source)

Reads a local image file and encodes it as a data URI for Discord image attributes, including guild emojis and emoji collection entries. File-content changes update the data URI even when the path stays the same. Sticker resources require a file path instead.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file` (String) The path to the local image file.

### Read-Only

- `data_uri` (String) The base64-encoded data URI of the image (e.g., `data:image/png;base64,...`).
